At the fixture's ~0.1 mA signal level there is no ampacity issue, but there is no redundancy.

It is a robustness observation appropriate to a disposable fixture: acceptable here, but worth knowing the GND net has exactly one inter-layer path and no declared fab criterion covers the 0.15 mm annular ring.

Any settled value — including one revealing a wrong C or a loading error — would still yield 'pass' as long as the 1 ms point happened to land in band. findings.reasoning: The measured 5 ms value does independently match my analytic expectation (1-exp(-5)=0.99326), so no electrical problem is indicated. Flagged so the pass verdict is read as verifying exactly one point on the curve.

limitations: Tool-free review: I could not refill the zone, re-run DRC/ERC/ngspice, or open work/rc-step/result.raw (binary, retained for operator); electrical conclusions rest on the logged .meas values plus my independent analytic calculation.

The thermal-spoke region of the saved zone polygon around J1 pad 3 was checked for plausibility and position, but spoke continuity was not re-computed geometrically point-by-point; I rely partly on DRC's zero unconnected items for final zone connectivity.
